name: What should I prepare before meeting with a basement contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a basement contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your design consultation, start by identifying your primary goals for the space, whether that is a home theater, gym, guest suite, or children's play area. Take initial measurements and check your utility area, noting the location of your water heater, furnace, main water shut-off, and electrical panel, as these cannot be walled off without proper code-compliant access doors. Gather photos or floor plan ideas you prefer and make a clear list of non-negotiable items versus optional upgrades to help guide accurate project pricing.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your desired uses, note mechanical systems like your furnace and breaker box, gather floor plan inspiration, and determine your priority features versus flexible upgrades.
